select bmr.id, bmr.room_name, bmr.reserve_name, bmr.room_id, bmr.start_time, bmr.end_time, bmr.reserve_uid, bmr.reserve_uname, bmr.reserve_staffid, bmr.real_start_time, bmr.real_end_time, bmr.real_start_type, bmr.real_end_type, bmr.in_valid_flag, bmr.status, bmr.cancel_flag, bmr.operate_uname, bmr.operate_staffid, bmr.operate_reason, bm.space_id from bbx_meeting_reserve bmr JOIN bbx_meeting_room bm ON bmr.room_id = bm.id
AND bmr.tenant_id =#{condition.tenantId}
AND bmr.reserve_name like concat('%',#{condition.reserveName},'%')
AND bmr.room_name like concat('%',#{condition.roomName},'%')
AND (bmr.reserve_uname like concat('%',#{condition.reserveUname},'%') or bmr.reserve_staffid =#{condition.reserveUname})
AND bmr.in_valid_flag =#{condition.inValidFlag} AND bmr.cancel_flag = 0
AND bmr.status =#{condition.status} AND bmr.cancel_flag = 0
AND (#{condition.startTime} <= bmr.end_time and #{condition.endTime} >= bmr.start_time)
AND bm.space_id in
#{spaceId}
AND bmr.draft = 0
order by bmr.start_time DESC

AND bmr.in_valid_flag =#{condition.inValidFlag} AND bmr.cancel_flag = 0
AND bmr.status =#{condition.status} AND bmr.cancel_flag = 0
AND (#{condition.startTime} <= bmr.end_time and #{condition.endTime} >= bmr.start_time)
AND bm.space_id in
#{spaceId}
AND bmr.draft = 0
order by bmr.start_time DESC
